response.overview: A group of beautiful girls, intrigue, and revenge. Susi (Cut Irna) is worried about the arrival of Lia (Anneke Putri), whom she believes could overshadow her popularity. Not to mention her worries about competing for Budi (Alvian). So Susi’s group kidnaps Lia and disfigures her face. One day, Susi’s house is robbed, but she’s relieved that the threat didn’t come from Lia. Later, a phone rings and the killer makes a threat. A massacre ensues.
